title: Gulf Front Seaside Vacation Rental with Beach Access Sleeps 4
meta_description: 1BR beachfront Seaside rental for 4 with Gulf views, direct beach access, a private balcony, and a screened porch by the dunes.
description_expanded: A Romantic Beachfront Escape on the GulfWelcome to About Time, a serene Gulf-front honeymoon home in Seaside, Florida, where the rhythm of the waves and sweeping beach views set the tone for a truly unforgettable stay. This charming one-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bath vacation rental offers front-row access to the sugar-white sands, with the beach just steps from your back door. Designed for relaxation and romance, the bright, all-white interior mirrors the coastal landscape outside, creating a calm and airy retreat along Scenic Highway 30A.Light-Filled Living & Indoor–Outdoor Coastal LivingThe spacious living room features soaring ceilings that enhance the open, breezy feel of the home. A deluxe queen sleeper sofa provides additional sleeping space, while a large flat-screen TV makes it easy to unwind after a day in the sun. Thoughtful built-ins, including a wall-sized storage cabinet for beach essentials, keep the space both functional and inviting.The updated kitchen is fully equipped with everything needed to prepare casual meals or beach-day snacks. Just beyond, step onto the expansive Gulf-front balcony, where a bar-height breakfast table seats four for effortless beachfront dining. A charming bed swing invites you to linger with your morning coffee or enjoy an evening breeze as the sun sets over the water.Private Bedroom Retreat & Spa-Inspired BathDownstairs, the peaceful primary bedroom features a luxurious king bed and a flat-screen TV, offering a quiet escape after a day at the beach. The en-suite bathroom showcases a beautiful marble shower with an oversized glass enclosure, delivering a spa-like experience in the comfort of your own home.Just outside the bedroom, an enclosed screened-in porch is tucked among the sand dunes and framed with privacy curtains for added seclusion. Furnished with two Adirondack chairs, this tranquil nook is the perfect place to sip coffee at sunrise, listen to the waves roll in, and enjoy moments of complete serenity.Wake Up to the Gulf at Your DoorstepAfter a restful night, step onto the upper balcony and lean over the railing to watch the morning tide roll in—an unforgettable reminder that you’ve chosen the perfect beachfront getaway. Whether you’re celebrating a honeymoon, anniversary, or simply craving a peaceful escape, About Time delivers unmatched Gulf-front charm and relaxation.Come experience the beauty, tranquility, and romance of About Time, your private slice of paradise in Seaside, Florida.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES672 square feet of thoughtfully designed beachfront living spacePrivate Seaside Residential Beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private residential beach along Scenic Highway 30AApprox. 36 feet / 1-minute walk to beach accessGulf-front location with stunning, unobstructed Gulf of Mexico viewsCompact refrigerator provided for convenience and a freestanding ice makerThis home streams live TV through YouTube TV, so you can catch local channels, sports, and favorite shows right from the smart TVs.No washer or dryer on-siteNo outdoor showerPeacock Alley linens throughout the home, featuring fresh, luxurious towels and sheetsAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities provided upon arrivalGolf cart policy: golf carts are considered vehicles; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited—special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets permitted STR23-002214
